facts.menuNote: Prices from their Oakland online ordering menu; food prices are the same at all six shops, only the canned beer differs.
facts.siteNote: All pizzas come with a cheddar cheese edge and mozzarella. Any pie can be made dairy free for $2 more or gluten free for $3 more; they decline other add-ons, modifications and swaps, and are not a certified gluten-free kitchen.

glenn: 27 Oct 7:34 pm: screenshots of squarepieguys.com and Instagram @squarepieguys (verified, 'Detroit 🍕 in The Bay', 126K followers, 'SF, Oakland, Walnut Creek, Campbell, Palo Alto'), 'Multiple locations / BEASTY • Eats'.
flags: 70 items from the Oakland ordering menu, their own names and wording kept; the repeated ordering notes ('we respectfully decline add-on requests...', gluten-free disclaimer, slice counts) were cut from descriptions and summed up in siteNote. The 'Crowd favorites' strip repeats four items and was left out.
Their Oakland ordering page lists 'Canned Local Beer - All' twice (5 items, then the same minus Can Love Hazy IPA); kept once.

Canned beer differs by shop: SoMa and Ghirardelli have Kolsch $7 and Golden State Cider $9; Walnut Creek has Sincere Cider $9; Palo Alto only Can Love Hazy IPA $9; Campbell has no beer, only the canned wine. Everything else is identical at all six.
Hoptonic Green Tea and Hoptonic Earl Grey show '$5.00+' on the ordering page but $0 in its data; $5.00 used.
Six shops on their site, matching Glenn's screenshots; all hours and phones match. The Oakland page adds '(on Dr. Huey P. Newton Way)'.
Shop emails (their site capitalises them): oakland@, soma@, thesquare@ (Ghirardelli), walnutcreek@, campbell@, paloalto@squarepieguys.com. Only Oakland's is in facts.email.
Color #1630FF is the blue in their logo and ordering-site theme.
Instagram not opened; the follower count and bio are from Glenn's screenshot.
